name: nl-income-tax
description: Dutch personal income tax (inkomstenbelasting) for a resident individual, tax year 2026, with 2025 figures for returns still open. Covers the three boxes: box 1 bands (8.10% tax plus 27.65% national insurance in the first band, 37.56%, 49.50%) and the AOW-age rates; the tariefsaanpassing; the algemene heffingskorting and arbeidskorting with their phase-outs; the inkomensafhankelijke combinatiekorting and ouderenkorting; box 2 at 24.5% and 31%; box 3 for 2026 under the bridging law, the Hoge Raad rulings and the tegenbewijsregeling (actual return); fiscal-partner allocation; the 1 May return, extensions, voorlopige aanslag, belastingrente and penalties. Trigger phrases: aangifte inkomstenbelasting, box 1 tarief, heffingskortingen, arbeidskorting, box 3 werkelijk rendement, tegenbewijsregeling, voorlopige aanslag, belastingrente.
